components.gap: Pairwise/mutual event independence and independence of TWO random variables are defined, and the source's Def. 4.1 conditional form with its null-event clause is recovered at 244-246. Missing: the source's Definition 4.4 (held PDF p.151, book p.143) defines mutual independence of n random variables X1,...,Xn (joint law of the vector is the product of the individual laws); the handbook defines random-variable independence only for a pair X,Y, so the n-variable source variant is not preserved. Also absent: the source's Definition 4.2 (PDF p.149) equivalent formulation of mutual independence of n events via every choice of A_j or its complement.

Conditional criterion, null events, complement closure for a pair, event criterion for two variables and the two-factor product S x T are stated and proved. Missing: the source's product construction is n-fold (Def. 4.5 independent trials process, held PDF p.152, book p.144: Omega=R x...x R with product distribution and mutually independent coordinates X1..Xn); the handbook proves only the two-factor product and complement closure only for two events, while the alert example (316-330) itself uses a three-factor product p_2(h,u,v). Supply the n-factor product construction with mutual independence of the coordinates (and the n-event complement criterion) with written proofs.

Total expectation over positive blocks, averaging property, a.s. uniqueness; proof written; worked check 440-451; source Thm 6.5 PDF pp.247-248.
